themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers research conducted by or involving AI agents that can autonomously perform tasks, learn, and make decisions to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Examines AI applications that condense large amounts of text into shorter, digestible summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Covers how AI is affecting jobs, skills, training, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI's role in assisting with design tasks and enhancing user research processes.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems that create new content, including text, images, and potentially other media.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for research and testing.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Content that reviews, compares, or assesses the effectiveness and usability of AI tools for research and design.

themes.name: AI-assisted recruitment
themes.description: Examines the use of AI in the hiring process, from sourcing candidates to screening and interviewing.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
